title: Classic of Poetry / Book of Songs
description: New position 5 in the owner-supplied audited Chinese-language revision. Song, ritual, labor, courtship and political complaint share a remarkably durable language of repetition and indirection. Its collective and internally varied character is a strength. Its importance is literary as well as educational and canonical.
